EVAL at half load (WildChat window 2, time_scale 2.0). Companion to costmodel_wildchat_2d_v2: same three arms, same H100 regions, same held-out window, but the 30-min trace replays over 60 min (5.7 rps) so the fleet runs unsaturated and the client honors the open-loop schedule. gorgo-2d runs STATIC at the weights learned in v2's ts=1.0 window-1 tune (rtt_weight=2.0 at the box ceiling, queue_weight=0.104, ratio 19.2 ~ the physical H100 prior) -- matching the paper's tune-at-1x / eval-at-ts2 protocol. Run as a base spec with no eval chain and no auto_tune.

Purpose: v2 at ts=1.0 was closed-loop saturated (client slip ~15 min in every arm); the paper's load sweep says saturation trades gorgo's TTFT for E2E. This run measures the same policies at the unsaturated operating point.
